manifest.description: Renders HTML decks: PDF, a PNG per slide (to look at), and PowerPoint (a picture per slide).

tools.name: pdf
tools.description: Prints the deck to PDF, a page per slide.

tools.name: slides
tools.description: A PNG per slide (slide-01.png …, 1280 wide) in the folder out, to read and check.

tools.name: slide
tools.description: One slide (n, from 1) as slide-NN.png in the folder out.

tools.name: pptx
tools.description: A PowerPoint file, a full-slide picture per slide (not editable text).

text_files.Dockerfile:
# decks-render: headless Chromium to print HTML decks, poppler to turn pages
# into images, python-pptx for PowerPoint, and open fonts metric-compatible
# with the common ones (Arial/Helvetica, Times, Palatino), plus Inter and Noto.
FROM debian:bookworm-slim
RUN apt-get update \
 && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
      chromium poppler-utils python3 python3-pip python3-pil python3-lxml \
      fonts-liberation2 fonts-urw-base35 fonts-dejavu-core fonts-noto-core fonts-noto-color-emoji fonts-inter \
 && pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages python-pptx==1.0.2 \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
 && fc-cache -f
COPY render.py /opt/kit/render.py
text_files.render.py:
"""decks-render: an HTML deck (one page per slide, sized by its @page rule)
to PDF, to one PNG per slide, or to PowerPoint (a picture per slide)."""

import glob
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile


def pdf(html, out):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(out)), exist_ok=True)
    profile = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/tmp")
    cmd = [
        "chromium", "--headless", "--no-sandbox", "--disable-gpu", "--disable-dev-shm-usage",
        "--no-first-run", "--user-data-dir=" + profile, "--crash-dumps-dir=/tmp",
        "--no-pdf-header-footer", "--virtual-time-budget=5000", "--run-all-compositor-stages-before-draw",
        "--print-to-pdf=" + os.path.abspath(out), "file://" + os.path.abspath(html),
    ]
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    shutil.rmtree(profile, ignore_errors=True)
    if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(out):
        sys.exit("chromium could not print %s:\n%s" % (html, r.stderr[-4000:]))


def pages(pdf_path, out_dir, first=None, last=None, width=1280):
    """One PNG per page, slide-01.png …; returns their paths."""
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/tmp")
    cmd = ["pdftoppm", "-q", "-png", "-scale-to", str(width)]
    if first:
        cmd += ["-f", str(first), "-l", str(last or first)]
    subprocess.run(cmd + [pdf_path, os.path.join(tmp, "p")], check=True)
    out = []
    for p in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(tmp, "p-*.png")), key=lambda p: int(p.rsplit("-", 1)[1][:-4])):
        n = int(p.rsplit("-", 1)[1][:-4])
        dest = os.path.join(out_dir, "slide-%02d.png" % n)
        shutil.move(p, dest)
        out.append(dest)
    shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
    return out


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 4:
        sys.exit("usage: render.py pdf|slides|slide|pptx <deck.html> <out> [n]")
    what, html, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
    if what == "pdf":
        pdf(html, out)
        print("printed %s" % out)
        return
    tmp_pdf = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/tmp"), "deck.pdf")
    pdf(html, tmp_pdf)
    if what == "slides":
        made = pages(tmp_pdf, out)
        print("%d slides: %s" % (len(made), ", ".join(made)))
    elif what == "slide":
        n = int(sys.argv[4])
        made = pages(tmp_pdf, out, n, n)
        if not made:
            sys.exit("the deck has no slide %d" % n)
        print(made[0])
    elif what == "pptx":
        from pptx import Presentation
        from pptx.util import Emu
        imgs = pages(tmp_pdf, tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/tmp"), width=2560)
        prs = Presentation()
        prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height = Emu(12192000), Emu(6858000)
        for img in imgs:
            s = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
            s.shapes.add_picture(img, 0, 0, width=prs.slide_width, height=prs.slide_height)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(out)), exist_ok=True)
        prs.save(out)
        print("%d slides in %s" % (len(imgs), out))
    else:
        sys.exit("unknown: " + what)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
